name: delegate
description: Delegate work to external agents, end the Codex turn, and resume on completion without polling.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate to OpenCode or Codex without polling.
interface.longDescription: Run OpenCode or Codex through shared detached jobs and resume once through codex queue. Persist per-agent SRT preferences; Codex uses native sandboxing and automatic approval review.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $delegate:opencode to review the current changes without editing files.
